title: Friedl Richardson
description: friedlrichardson.com Friedl Richardson Trial Lawyers — Phoenix-based personal injury law firm founded 1997 by William J. Friedl (30+ yrs, AV Preeminent Martindale-Hubbell, Arizona Super Lawyers 2010-2013) and Thomas M. Richardson (Maricopa County Judicial Selection Committee, governor-appointed), nearly 100 years combined experience handling car/motorcycle/truck accidents, wrongful death, medical malpractice, dog bites, premises liability and work injuries across Arizona. Operates on pure contingency (free until settled), "trial-ready" with in-house registered nurse and expert network (investigators, engineers, architects). Landmark results: $6M wrongful death jury verdict, $1.4M child wrongful death, $1M teenager wrongful death, $710K car accident, $700K medical malpractice. Two offices: Phoenix (HQ, Cave Creek Rd) and Flagstaff; team includes Super Lawyers Rising Star Raechel Kane plus attorneys McCarthy, Vela, Zachar Hardy. Strong community presence — MADD, local sports sponsorship.
